requirement_vague: Verify JWT token contains correct user ID and username in payload

omissions.description: JWT payload does not include the user's id, username, and email as required.
omissions.reasoning: The token is generated by create_token(user_id), which only sets payload fields "sub" and "exp". There are no "id", "username", or "email" claims in the JWT payload, so decoding the middle segment will not produce the required values.
